title: MAMath-Bench: Process-Aware and Robust Evaluation of Multimodal Multi-Agent Mathematical Reasoning
authors: Xinping Wang, Jie Ma, Rui Xing, Wensong Guo, Xiayi Zhang, Jianhao Deng, Zihao Zhou, Boqian Yang, Feijuan He

one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26943，abs 页 Comments 为 'The dataset is available at this https URL'）：MAMath-Bench 是 process-aware 的多模态多 agent 数学推理 benchmark，规模是 '1,003 problems spanning 11 mathematical categories, multiple difficulty levels, and several modalities, including text, images, and audio'。它把评测拆成三个维度——'problem-solving correctness, reasoning-process reliability, and robustness to adversarial reasoning-chain perturbations'，并带 fine-grained milestone 标注。三条结论全部带否定色彩，这是今日最有迁移价值的一篇：(1) 'multi-agent collaboration does not consistently improve final-answer accuracy over strong single LLMs'；(2) 协作 'can substantially enhance the coverage of intermediate reasoning, but such gains may come at the cost of increased reasoning redundancy'；(3) 'current systems remain vulnerable to adversarial reasoning errors, particularly those involving subtle structural perturbations'。价值路由：这是今日唯一一篇直接改我们评测口径的论文——第 1 条否掉 '多 agent 一定更强' 的默认假设，第 2 条说明过程覆盖率与 token 冗余要一起记，第 3 条要求评测必须包含对推理链的对抗扰动（换单位、变题干结构）而不是只换数字。证据 / 代码：abs 页指向 https://github.com/mira-ai-lab/AgentMath ，但 github.com 今日从本机实测不可达（curl 返回 HTTP 000，非 404），无法确认该仓库与 benchmark 的对应关系与代码可得性，标注待核验/暂无；数据集 URL 论文以 'this https URL' 占位，摘要未展开。今日动作：把三维度（答案正确性 / 推理过程可靠性 / 对抗扰动鲁棒性）抄进内部 agent 评测模板，并把 '多 agent vs 强单模型' 设为必跑对照。
